prepare_agent.step_description: Ask the user what kind of image or post they want to create (e.g., social post, promo, artwork, etc.) — this defines the general purpose.
Ask the user to select or confirm the platform or destination (Instagram, LinkedIn, website, etc.).
Ask the user to pick the vibe or emotion they want the design to express (e.g., fun, calm, bold, professional).
Ask whether the user wants to include text, logo, or message in the design.
Ask the user to select a visual style preference (photo-realistic, 3D render, vector illustration, etc.).

processing_agent.step_description: Synthesize all user inputs (including the new 'platform') into a single structured payload for downstream generation.
Create a detailed image generation prompt using the structured payload, covering composition, subjects, style, and any branding elements.
Draft a compelling caption that incorporates the headline, CTA, aligns with the desired tone, and is optimized for the selected 'platform'.

execution_agent.step_description: Validate the 'image_prompt' and 'draft_caption' for quality, relevance, and alignment with user specifications; flag any issues.
Assemble the final deliverable package containing the validated image prompt, the final caption, and the original structured payload for reference.
